# R11 Valkyrie Quest in NetHack 5.0

## Summary

- **Portal floor:** The Quest portal is generated on one Dungeons of Doom level from 11 through 16, in a normal room without stairs. Entering the selected level triggers a telepathic plea from the Quest leader; for this role the leader is **The Norn**. The exact 5.0 message text is **UNVERIFIED** because 5.0 moved quest text into Lua. [Quest](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Quest) · [Magic portal](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Magic_portal) · [5.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/releases)
- **Access gate:** The Norn grants the normal quest assignment at XL 14 or higher, alignment record at least 20 (“piously aligned”), and unchanged original alignment. A neutral Valkyrie must still be Neutral and must not have converted. [5.0 `include/quest.h`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/include/quest.h#L326-L332) · [5.0 `src/quest.c:is_pure()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L142-L165)
- **Branch layout:** Home = **Temple of Light** (the Norn calls its shrine the **Shrine of Destiny**); leader = **The Norn**; locate = **The Cave of Surtur** (third Quest level); goal = **Lord Surtur’s Fortress** (bottom level). The home-level down stair is the entrance to the deeper Quest and is on the Norn’s level. [Valkyrie quest](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest) · [Quest](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Quest)
- **Nemesis:** Lord Surtur has two `2d10` weapon attacks and a `2d6` claw attack that steals the Quest artifact. He resists fire and stoning, but not cold. Fire resistance is a strong preparation; **levitation or fireproof water-walking boots** are for safely crossing lava. [5.0 `include/monsters.h`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/include/monsters.h#L3741-L3750) · [Valkyrie quest strategy](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest)
- **Loot:** Recover **The Orb of Fate** and the **Bell of Opening**. Return to The Norn carrying the Orb; keep the Bell for the later Invocation. The 5.0 quest code explicitly warns if the Bell is missing, but does not make it a prerequisite for marking the Quest complete. [5.0 `src/quest.c:finish_quest()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L245-L260)
- **Important 5.0 deltas from 3.6:** The alignment/XL thresholds remain 20/14, but 5.0 no longer seals the portal on the ordinary bad-alignment/converted/hostile-leader paths; killing the Quest leader can open the Quest. 5.0 also changes Valkyrie start equipment from a long sword to a spear, and changes the Valkyrie/warrior quest-monster alignment template from chaotic to lawful. [3.6.7 `src/quest.c`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NetHack/NetHack/NetHack-3.6.7_Released/src/quest.c) · [5.0 `src/quest.c`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c) · [5.0 fixes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L3179-L3189) · [5.0 fixes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L3962-L3964)

## Bot rules

**Rule 1 — Detect the portal level.**

- **Trigger:** Current branch is the Dungeons of Doom and the status line reports a dungeon depth in `11`–`16`; on first entry, a message indicates a faint/telepathic plea from **The Norn**, asks for urgent help, names the Temple/Shrine of Destiny, or gives the clue about a `...ic transporter`. Exact 5.0 text is **UNVERIFIED**; do not require one complete legacy sentence.
- **Action:** Store the current dungeon depth as the Quest-portal candidate. Search normal rooms, prioritizing rooms with no staircase. Reveal traps using an available trap-detection method; when a portal is revealed as `^`, step onto that square with the one-step direction key (`y`, `k`, `u`, `h`, `l`, `b`, `j`, or `n` according to position). No direction/yes-no prompt is expected for portal activation.
- **Done when:** The branch changes to the Quest and the character arrives on its home level.
- **If it fails:** If the message is absent, do not infer that every level in the 11–16 range contains the portal. Continue level exploration and retain the message-triggered candidate. If only ordinary traps are found, continue searching the room network; a portal is not guaranteed to be visible before detection/activation.
- **Evidence:** [Quest access](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Quest) · [Magic portal](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Magic_portal) · 5.0 quest text is Lua-backed ([release notes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/releases)), so the exact message text is **UNVERIFIED**.

**Rule 2 — Verify eligibility before chatting to The Norn.**

- **Trigger:** Home level reached; identify The Norn by monster description/name, not by assuming a glyph. Status shows `XL:14` or greater and current alignment `Neutral`. The bot’s event history must show no alignment conversion. Alignment record must be at least 20; the observable enlightenment phrase is `You are piously aligned.` (The ordinary status line does not provide the numeric record.)
- **Action:** If XL is below 14, leave through the home-level portal and gain levels before returning. If alignment record is below 20, improve it before another attempt. If an alignment-changing helm is worn, remove it with `T` and select the helm from the inventory menu; do not proceed until alignment is Neutral. To inspect general character/status information, press `Ctrl-X` (`#attributes`); this does **not** itself reveal alignment record. Use an enlightenment result or a self-probe/stethoscope result to test for `You are piously aligned.` when available.
- **Done when:** Preconditions pass: XL ≥14, record ≥20, Neutral current alignment, and no conversion recorded.
- **If it fails:** Do not repeatedly test The Norn while under-aligned. A deficient record gets a non-sealing rejection in 5.0, but the attempt wastes turns and the Norn’s message is not a substitute for a record check. A prior conversion is a different state from merely wearing the wrong helm; track conversion history and treat converted status as not eligible.
- **Evidence:** [5.0 `include/quest.h`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/include/quest.h#L326-L332) · [5.0 `src/quest.c:is_pure()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L142-L165) · [5.0 Guidebook, `Ctrl-X`](https://nethack.org/v500/Guidebook.html) · [Alignment record phrases](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Enlightenment).

**Rule 3 — Get the assignment from The Norn.**

- **Trigger:** Adjacent to The Norn on the Quest home level; her name/description identifies the leader. The Temple of Light is also called the Shrine of Destiny in the older role text.
- **Action:** Invoke chat with `M-c` (Meta+c; on terminals without a Meta key, use the configured `Esc`-then-`c` equivalent), then answer the direction prompt with the cardinal direction of The Norn. Do not use `C`: in 5.0 that is `#call`/name, not chat. There are no dialogue-choice answers.
- **Done when:** The Norn grants the assignment; the legacy transcript tells the Valkyrie to find the Cave of Surtur, go down to Lord Surtur’s lair, defeat him, and return the Orb. Exact 5.0 sentence text is **UNVERIFIED**.
- **If it fails:** Re-check the prerequisites and the Norn’s hostility. If the leader is hostile, the 5.0 code no longer permanently seals the quest merely because she is angry; killing the leader is an emergency access path, not a preferred action. Avoid accidental attacks on The Norn.
- **Evidence:** [5.0 Guidebook: `M-c` is `#chat`](https://nethack.org/v500/Guidebook.html) · [5.0 `src/quest.c:chat_with_leader()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L297-L342) · [5.0 `src/quest.c:leader_speaks()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L345-L364).

**Rule 4 — Enter the deeper Quest from the home level.**

- **Trigger:** Assignment was granted; map shows the home-level down staircase `>`.
- **Action:** Path to the `>` square using safe one-step movement; press `>` while standing on it. The home level is not a place to rely on teleportation or digging; use the stairs.
- **Done when:** Status changes to Quest level 2 (the upper filler level).
- **If it fails:** Re-scan the home-level map for the stair. The stair is on the same level as The Norn, but its exact coordinate is not portable across games/confirmed 5.0 map data.
- **Evidence:** [Quest branch layout](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Quest) · [Valkyrie quest home level](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).

**Rule 5 — Recognize and traverse the locate level.**

- **Trigger:** Quest level 3; on first entry the message describes ice/snow giving way to a valley floor, a huge round hill, and pools of lava. The role transcript identifies this as the entrance to the Cave of Surtur. Exact 5.0 Lua wording is **UNVERIFIED**. On ASCII maps, lava is normally `}`; honor the environment’s configured symbol mapping.
- **Action:** Search for the down staircase and path to it. Do not route across `}` lava unless levitating/flying or wearing fireproof water-walking boots. Keep fire resistance active; do not infer that fire resistance alone makes a lava crossing safe.
- **Done when:** Press `>` on the down staircase and reach the lower filler level.
- **If it fails:** Reconstruct the reachable map instead of guessing the level’s coordinates. The 5.0-specific exact map and all fixed feature coordinates are **UNVERIFIED**.
- **Evidence:** [Valkyrie quest locate transcript](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest) · [Quest branch layout](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Quest) · [lava strategy](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).

**Rule 6 — Prepare before the goal level and handle Surtur.**

- **Trigger:** Near the bottom of the Quest; message describes sulphurous gas, a rock palisade, and a moat of bubbling lava, or map/monster inspection identifies Lord Surtur. Exact 5.0 message wording is **UNVERIFIED**. Surtur is a giant (`H` in the standard glyph set); use a monster description/name to distinguish him from other giants.
- **Action:** Before crossing lava, ensure one safe crossing method is active: levitation (wear with `P`, then select the levitation ring; or `W`, then select levitation boots) or fireproof water-walking boots (`W`, select boots). Confirm active properties with `Ctrl-X`/status (`Lev`, `Fly`, `You are fire resistant.`). Keep fire resistance active. Clear nearby fire ants/fire giants from safe ground. Engage Surtur from a stable tile; cold damage is preferred if available. A wand of striking can wake him at range, but do not zap while standing on/near a drawbridge. Avoid drawbridge squares and their blast/debris risk.
- **Done when:** Lord Surtur is dead; the Orb and Bell can be collected from the square/drop inventory.
- **If it fails:** If a lava route cannot be crossed under a verified safe movement state, retreat and find a different route or obtain the necessary gear. Do not step into lava to “test” fire resistance. If Surtur is not the visible giant, inspect the monster before attacking; `H` alone is not a unique identifier.
- **Evidence:** [5.0 `include/monsters.h:Lord Surtur`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/include/monsters.h#L3741-L3750) · [Lord Surtur](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Lord_Surtur) · [Valkyrie quest strategy](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).

**Rule 7 — Collect both quest items and keep them.**

- **Trigger:** Surtur is dead; the Orb is on/near his square and the Bell drops from his inventory. The Bell may be described only as `a silver bell` until identified; the 5.0 Wiki baseline places it in the nemesis’s inventory.
- **Action:** Stand on the drop square and press `m,` to force a pickup-selection menu. Select the entries whose descriptions are the Orb of Fate and silver bell; answer any quantity prompt with the quantity shown for that selected stack. Then press `i` and verify both are in inventory. NetHack 5.0 changed default autopickup to off, so do not rely on walking over either item.
- **Done when:** Inventory contains The Orb of Fate and Bell of Opening (possibly still displayed as `silver bell`).
- **If it fails:** Reinspect Surtur’s square and adjacent floor objects; make sure the Bell was not overlooked among drops. Do not leave the level until both items are confirmed. Do not apply or invoke the Bell during this quest unless a specific need justifies spending charges.
- **Evidence:** [Bell of Opening](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Bell_of_Opening) · [Orb of Fate](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/OOF) · [5.0 fixes: autopickup default off](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L3191-L3194) · [5.0 Guidebook: `,` pickup](https://nethack.org/v500/Guidebook.html).

**Rule 8 — Return the Orb to The Norn and confirm quest completion.**

- **Trigger:** Inventory includes The Orb of Fate; Quest branch route back to the home level is known; The Norn is alive and reachable (or the bot is using a known fallback).
- **Action:** Ascend using `<` at each up staircase through the goal/filler/locate/upper-filler levels to the Temple of Light. Move adjacent to The Norn; press `M-c`, then the cardinal direction toward her. Do not throw the Orb. Keep the Bell in inventory.
- **Done when:** The Norn delivers the post-quest/Orb-return message and the game marks the Quest completed. In 5.0 code, presenting the artifact calls `finish_quest()` and sets `qcompleted`; if the Bell is absent, a separate warning is issued.
- **If it fails:** Check that the Orb is actually in the hero’s inventory (not merely on the floor or inside a container); chat again after reaching the leader. If the response says the Bell is missing, return to the goal level and retrieve it before leaving the Quest for good.
- **Evidence:** [5.0 `src/quest.c:chat_with_leader()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L283-L292) · [5.0 `src/quest.c:finish_quest()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L245-L260) · [Valkyrie quest victory text](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).

## Risks and exceptions

- **Lava is the major environmental hazard.** The Valkyrie-quest Wiki strategy warns that lava and drawbridge deaths outnumber deaths to Surtur in the cited NAO statistics; those statistics are historical and not a 5.0 measurement. Bring fire resistance and use levitation or fireproof water-walking boots to cross lava. Do not use fire resistance alone as a crossing method. [Valkyrie quest strategy](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest) (Wiki statistics are not version-verified for 5.0).
- **Drawbridges can kill even a well-equipped character.** Exploding/collapsing bridge debris is a documented Valkyrie-quest death mechanism. Do not stand on a drawbridge while waking Surtur with a wand of striking, and do not assume a ranged attack is safe if the line crosses/targets the bridge. [Valkyrie quest strategy](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).
- **Surtur’s claw can steal the Quest artifact.** His 5.0 definition includes an `AD_SAMU` `2d6` claw attack; do not grab the Orb and then let him hit you. Kill him before looting, and avoid keeping the Orb exposed to him while he is alive. [5.0 `include/monsters.h`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/include/monsters.h#L3741-L3748) · [Lord Surtur](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Lord_Surtur).
- **Fire resistance is not the same as lava mobility.** Fire resistance mitigates fire hazards and the lava danger described by the Wiki; levitation or fireproof water-walking boots are the stated way to cross pools without dissolving. [Valkyrie quest strategy](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).
- **Do not confuse the Bell with an ordinary bell.** Its unidentified appearance is `silver bell`; it is a unique Invocation item. Preserve it for the later Invocation. The Wiki lists 3 starting charges and 5 maximum; in 5.0 these values are **not independently confirmed here**. [Bell of Opening](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Bell_of_Opening).
- **The Orb is useful while carried.** Its listed passive effects are warning, half physical damage, half spell damage, and luckstone behavior. Do not apply it if the bot has evidence it is cancelled: the crystal-ball base item can implode when a cancelled Orb is applied. [Orb of Fate](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/OOF).
- **A missing Bell does not appear to block Quest completion.** 5.0 `finish_quest()` sets the completion flag for the presented artifact and separately prints a missing-Bell reminder. For a real ascension, the bot should still retrieve the Bell because it is required for Invocation. [5.0 `src/quest.c:finish_quest()`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L245-L260) · [Bell of Opening](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Bell_of_Opening).
- **Avoid attacking The Norn.** In 3.6.7, angering the leader led to `expulsion(TRUE)` and portal sealing; 5.0 explicitly avoids ending the quest permanently this way and adds the killed-leader progression flag. This is an emergency fallback, not a recommended bot tactic. [3.6.7 `src/quest.c`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NetHack/NetHack/NetHack-3.6.7_Released/src/quest.c#L297-L313) · [5.0 `src/quest.c`](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0.0_Released/src/quest.c#L128-L134) · [5.0 fix](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/blob/NetHack-5.0/doc/fixes5-0-0.txt#L3179-L3181).

## Open questions

- **UNVERIFIED — exact 5.0 portal-level message.** 5.0 quest text was moved to Lua. The Norn-specific `firsttime`/`nexttime` telepathic portal messages were not independently extracted from the 5.0 Lua resource, so the bot should match semantic anchors (`The Norn`, plea/help, Temple/Shrine of Destiny, portal/transporter clue) rather than an exact legacy full string. [5.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack/releases).
- **UNVERIFIED — exact 5.0 Norn/locate/goal dialogue.** The Valkyrie Quest Wiki gives the familiar role text, including the Cave of Surtur and lava/palisade descriptions, but this transcript is not a direct 5.0 Lua-source verification. [Valkyrie quest](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).
- **UNVERIFIED — 5.0 fixed-level map coordinates and random feature details.** The role Wiki map is useful as a 3.6/3.7-era baseline, but exact stair, drawbridge, trap, moat, monster, and item coordinates or generation frequencies were not compared with the 5.0 tag. The bot should navigate from observed map state, not hard-coded coordinates. [Valkyrie quest](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Valkyrie_quest).
- **UNVERIFIED — 5.0 Bell/Orb generation implementation details.** The Wiki says the Orb is blessed with 5 charges on the nemesis square and the Bell is in the nemesis’s inventory with 3 charges; this answer did not independently inspect the 5.0 artifact/level-generation code for those numbers. Verify by reading the 5.0 inventory and item status in-game rather than assuming charges or exact placement. [Orb of Fate](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/OOF) · [Bell of Opening](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Bell_of_Opening).
